cards.back: Mitosis is the process of cell division that results in two identical diploid cells.
Ribosomes are responsible for protein synthesis in cells.
Deoxyribonucleic acid, the molecule that carries genetic information.
The process by which plants convert light energy into chemical energy.
The basic structural and functional unit of all living organisms.
A semi-permeable barrier that surrounds and protects the cell.
The control center of the cell that contains genetic material.
The gel-like substance that fills the cell and contains organelles.
The powerhouse of the cell that produces energy through cellular respiration.
A network of membranes that transports materials within the cell.
Cell division that produces four haploid cells for sexual reproduction.
A segment of DNA that codes for a specific protein or trait.
The process by which organisms better adapted to their environment survive and reproduce.
The gradual change in species over time through natural selection.
A community of living organisms and their physical environment.
